keywords: Future forecast 2.Framework analysis 3.Systems thinking 4.Scenario planning 5.Strategic planning
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn how to systematically explore the future and gain insight into the future from both medium-term and long-term perspectives. Students will then analyze historical transition patterns, identify trends and key drivers, and understand tools for forecasting possible future trajectories. Students will also develop the ability to apply the acquired tools to problem solving.
advice: The aims of the course are that the students should - be able to explain the differences between various methods and tools. - be able to point out risks and benefits with the methods and tools in the course. - be able to use their knowledge for planning various types of scenario to social issues. The course will include exercises to forecast sustainable future strategies for social issues. Students should be actively engaged in individual and group work.

activityGoals.body: Understand the concept of futures studies.
Understand methods and tools for future studies and forecasting.
Apply the acquired tools to state analysis and forecasting.
Forecast future society based on thinking and propose future scenarios.
